I googled it and the results that gave me was Abdominal Aorta Aneurysm. But i read that it was very rare to have AAA at my age.

Fast forward a day later. I started to feel/see it more when im sitting, laying down and sometimes standing up. I also felt mild pain that goes away quickly on my abdomen and sometimes weird sensations. So lately my anxiety has been through the roof.

I have heard that skinny people can feel and see their abdominal aorta moving especially laying down. But like i said i'm not skinny. I can still feel it now, the faster/harder my heart beats the more i feel it.

I'll eventually tell my parents to get me checked. I have been worrying about this lately. So i appreciate it if someone replied to this post. Thanks :^)
